content.stem: 一家金融机构计划采用具备人工智能(AI)/机器学习(ML)功能的系统来实施负面媒体报道筛查。在测试期间，该系统生成了大量不相关的新闻文章供审核。解决这个问题的最佳方法是什么？

options.A: 精简媒体来源，避免无关文章
options.B: 依靠调查人员的人工筛选
options.C: 提高向媒体渠道更新的频率
options.D: 调整人工智能/机器学习模型，使其重点关注高风险关键词/短语，并优先使用可信媒体来源

content.stem_en: During testing of media screening with artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning (ML) capabilities, the system produces high volumes of irrelevant news articles for review. What is the best way to address this issue?

options_en.A: Narrow the media sources to avoid unrelated articles
options_en.B: Rely on manual filtering by investigators
options_en.C: Increase the frequency of updates to media sources
options_en.D: Adjust AI/ML models to focus on high-risk keywords or phrases from reputable media sources
